title: AgentSurface
description: The SDK-neutral interoperability contract (0000 §4, 0010 §3) — the ONLY handle a workforce agent holds. Five verbs: write memory, retrieve, receive skill bindings, call models via the layer's Model Gateway, signal. GraphSpec (0008) compiles onto this surface; 'a field can be doing anything' stays true because the surface, not the SDK, is what governance sees.

identity.description: The leased, becky-issued identity this surface is bound to.

ops.description: Which verbs this lease grants — attenuation applies to the surface too.

ModelCall.description: A request at the Model Gateway (0000 §2 — no agent calls a model ungoverned). The per-identity budget rides the lease token's constraints.budget (0006 §3).

pinned.description: true ⇒ a SkillStandard.model_tier pin — a floor. Locked 2026-07-02: pinned calls FAIL honestly when unaffordable; they never silently degrade.

ModelCallResult.description: Locked 2026-07-02: degrade-where-pins-allow. A degraded call is honestly flagged — drift/canary can tell budget-dips from skill rot.

Signal.description: Intra-field transport (0010 §1). Locked 2026-07-02: signals are transport by default; anything state-changing MUST land as a MemoryRecord to have happened — 'if it's not memory, it didn't happen.' The Tier Profile signal_capture dial (none | state-changing | full) is the first concrete member of wild-vs-REAL.
